description: This file defines utilities for sharing content via deep linking in an iOS application, including constructing URLs, message formatting, and content cleaning.

classes.name: SharedContentPayload
classes.description: A data structure representing shared content with optional title, URL, and text.

methods.name: buildURL
methods.description: Constructs a deep link URL with a formatted message based on the payload and instruction.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Creates a formatted message string from the payload and instruction, limited to 2400 characters.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newlines from a string, returning nil if the string is empty.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Limits the string to a maximum number of characters.
